turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pretty good, thanks for asking.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I finally want to patch the hole my kid put in the hallway wall.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Oh no. How big is it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: About the size of a fist.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then you can use a mesh patch kit or cut in a small piece of new drywall. Which sounds more like you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pause for a bit, my kid needs me. I'll come back to you when I'm done.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay, no rush.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Jordan, are you bringing the map or should I?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I've got it on my phone.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's no signal up there though.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I downloaded it, it works offline.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, but I'm bringing the paper one too. Just in case your battery dies.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: You're such a scout. Fine, bring it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What do you want for dinner?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I don't mind, maybe pasta?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. Still thinking about that fist sized hole, patch kit or drywall piece?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let's do it properly with a new piece of drywall.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good call for a hole that size. Cut the opening into a neat square first so the new piece fits snugly.
